lineage.strategy: Add product-level design-win economics and deployment breadth rather than repeat quarterly financials.

observations.fact: Mobileye announced that select Stellantis vehicles expected in 2027 will integrate its Cloud-Enhanced ADAS using REM road intelligence.
Mobileye said five of the world's ten largest automakers contribute data to REM, which generated data from more than 8 million vehicles covering 34 billion miles in the prior year.

In its Q2 business overview Mobileye characterized gross profit per unit for the Stellantis Cloud-Enhanced ADAS program as roughly equivalent to Surround ADAS and more than double current average base-ADAS profitability.

risks.risk: The program is expected to begin in 2027, so nominated deployment and stated per-unit economics are forward-looking and remain exposed to OEM launch timing and production volumes.

unknowns.unknown: The release does not disclose contracted unit volume, program lifetime revenue, or realized gross profit for the Stellantis deployment.

recommendation: Use the Stellantis win and REM fleet breadth as demand/data-advantage evidence; treat profitability statements as program expectations until production converts them into realized results.
